1.w: for the divisions of the gatekeepers: Of the Korahites: Meshelemiah son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.

2.w: And the sons of Meshelemiah: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,

3.w: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Eliehoenai the seventh.

4.w: And to Obed-edom [were] sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethanel the fifth,

5.w: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peulthai the eighth, for God blessed him.

6.w: And to Shemaiah his son were born sons who governed throughout the house of their father, because they [were] mighty ones of valor.

7.w: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, and Rephael, and Obed, Elzabad; his brothers [were] sons of valor, Elihu and Semachiah.

8.w: All these [were] of the sons of Obed-edom; they and their sons and their brothers, men of valor with power for work—sixty-two of Obed-edom.

9.w: And to Meshelemiah [were] sons and brothers, sons of valor—eighteen.

10.w: And to Hosah of the sons of Merari [were] sons: Shimri the first (although he was not the firstborn, his father made him the first),

11.w: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth—all the sons and brothers of Hosah, thirteen.

12.w: Among these [were] the divisions of the gatekeepers, the heads of the mighty ones [having] duties just like their brothers, to serve in the house of YHWH.

13.w: And they cast lots, the small as well as the great, according to the house of their fathers, for each gate.

14.w: And the lot fell for the East to Shelemiah. And [for] Zechariah his son, a wise counselor, they cast lots, and his lot came out for the North.

15.w: To Obed-edom the South, and to his sons the house of the gatherings.

16.w: To Shuppim and Hosah for the West, with the Shallecheth Gate on the ascending highway. A guard [was] alongside a guard.

17.w: To the east the Levites [were] six, to the north day by day four, to the south day by day four, and at the storehouse two [by] two.

18.w: At Parbar on the west, [were] four at the highway [and] two at Parbar.

19.w: These [were] the divisions of the gatekeepers among the sons of the Korahite and among the sons of Merari.

20.w: And of the Levites, Ahijah [was] over the treasuries of the house of God and over the treasuries of the holy things.

21.w: The sons of Laadan, the sons of the Gershonite, of Ladan, the heads of the fathers of Laadan the Gershonite [were] Jehieli,

22.w: the sons of Jehieli: Zetham, and Joel his brother, over the treasuries of the house of YHWH.

23.w: Of the Amramite, the Izharite, the Hebronite, and the Uzzielite:

24.w: And Shebuel son of Gershom son of Moses [was] overseer of the treasuries.

25.w: And his brothers through Eliezer: Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.

26.w: This Shelomoth and his brothers [were] over all the treasuries of the holy things that David the king and the heads of the fathers, even heads of thousands and of hundreds, and the captains of the army, had dedicated.

27.w: From the battles and from the plunder they dedicated to strengthen the house of YHWH,

28.w: and all that Samuel the seer, and Saul son of Kish, and Abner son of Ner, and Joab son of Zeruiah, had dedicated—all sanctified under the hand of Shelomith and his brothers.

29.w: Of the Izharite: Chenaniah and his sons unto the outside work [were] over Israel as officials and judges.

30.w: Of the Hebronite: Hashabiah and his brothers, sons of valor, a thousand and seven hundred, [were] over the inspection of Israel on the west side of the Jordan for all the business of YHWH, and in the service of the king.

31.w: Of the Hebronite, Jerijah [was] the head of the Hebronite, according to the generations of his fathers. In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought, and there were found among them mighty men of valor at Jazer of Gilead.

32.w: And his brothers, sons of valor, two thousand and seven hundred heads of the fathers, king David appointed over the Reubenite, and the Gadite, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, for every matter of God and matter of the king.
